messages:
Noah - AE: Verdigris wants a 10-day POC. Deliverables: chat streaming, embeddings, and a fine-tuned 13B variant. They called out HIPAA + SAML SSO.
Lina - Sales Eng: Do we have the model artifact details? quantization?
Noah - AE: They said qlora + nf4 in safetensors, tokenizer.json included.
Arun - ML Eng: nf4 + qlora usually loads but needs a scan. I'll run `compat-check verdigris-13b.tar.gz --quick` and report back.
InfraBot: Pool availability: "poc-east-1" shows 2x A100 spare for requested window.
Arun - ML Eng: Quick scan: tokenizer loads, 14 OOV tokens (we can map), model loads but attention op uses legacy kernel -> will need a small adapter shim. Estimate 36-48h engineering + 24h perf runs.
Lina - Sales Eng: Timeline risk noted. Price proposal for POC: $4,500 reserved + $0.65 per 1k tokens over baseline. Conditional on adapter ETA.
Hanna - Security: HIPAA only on Dedicated/Private. BYOK supported on Private; need KMS ARN, key policy, signed BAA/DPA before data ingest. Also request their pen-test summary.
Noah - AE: I'll ask Verdigris to return signed BAA + KMS details within 3 business days.
Arun - ML Eng: Opened ENG ticket ENG-8365 for adapter + streaming regression tests. Will attach perf matrix; ETA patch 48h, validation 24h.
Lina - Sales Eng: Action items: Noah collects legal/KMS, Hanna sends security questionnaire, Arun posts ENG updates, I'll send provisional quote and schedule kickoff.
Noah - AE: Thanks — I'll update thread with customer replies.
Lina - Sales Eng: One more note: recommend customers consider a qint8 re-export if latency target is strict; will include as optional path in the SOW.
